entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Santosh Kumar Tripathi
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
No one appears on behalf of the opposite party no.2 despite service of notice.

2. In terms of the FIR in question, it was stated that the daughter of the informant got missing 26.01.2023 and was recovered on 30.01.2023 and on recovery, it was informed that a rape was committed on her.
In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., she made allegations against some boys, whose name she did not disclose.
Thereafter, she made allegations against the applicant of forcing the victim to have physical relation with other persons.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim made allegations against one Sameer, who had taken her to the home of the applicant.
The allegation of rape was made against Sameer and two other persons.

1 3.

entities.text: Smt Farzana vs State Of U.P.And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the said co-accused Sameer and two other co-accused have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
The co-accused Sameer has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 03.08.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.32189 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.32189 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the main accused, against whom allegation of commission of rape was levelled, has been enlarged on bail and the role of the applicant was that of involving her immoral trafficking coupled with the fact that the applicant is a lady and is in custody since 01.02.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Smt. Farzana be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.81 of 2023, under Sections 376/34, 120B IPC, Section 16/17 read with Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, and Sections 3,4,5,6,7, and 8 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, Police Station Tajganj, District Agra on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
